newsitem.title: UK: Northern to close Ashby bottling dairy.
newsitem.headline: Northern to close Ashby bottling dairy.

text.p: British food producer Northern Foods will close its bottling dairy at Ashby, northern England in early December, with the loss of about 20 jobs, said Jo Stewart managing director of Northern's prepared food division.
"The major change has been taking 40 percent of bottling capacity out over the last two to three years, so the major reduction is behind us," said Stewart in an interview.
In future, the dairy business will be pruned and job losses small and infrequent, he said.
Northern's 1995 profits included a 91 million stg charge related to the restructuring of its dairy operations, a move which resulted in staff cuts of some 3,300.
The dairy restructuring came in response to increasing share of milk sales being taken by the large supermarkets at the expense of Britain's traditional, but more expensive, doorstep milk delivery.
But the pace of decline in doorstep milk sales has since slowed, averaging nine percent across the busines in the six months ended September 30, said Northern.
